title: Animals and embedding
hints: Inside `Dog` methods, `d.Name` is the promoted field `d.Animal.Name`. You don't need to write `Speak` or `Rename` for `Dog` or `GuideDog`: embedding promotes them.
`NewDog` builds a nested keyed literal: `Dog{Animal: Animal{Name: name, Sound: "woof"}, Breed: breed}`. In `Dog.Describe`, default the breed to `"dog"` when it's empty.
`GuideDog.Describe` calls the shadowed method explicitly: `s := g.Dog.Describe()`, then `if g.Handler != "" { s += " guiding " + g.Handler }`. Calling `g.Describe()` inside it would recurse forever.
